subject: Bid CityTowers' projects for free
body:
Hi George,

40 condo corporations. 5,450 units. That is a serious pipeline of work going out to bid.

I'm Rishon, founder of PMRFP (pmrfp.com). Post your building project RFPs for free, and licensed, vetted trades come to you. No cost to property managers, ever.

Want in? Reply here, or post your next project at pmrfp.com.
